@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The government i______ed a warning about heavy rainfall, urging residents to stay indoors and avoid unnecessary travel.
= issued
~詞義 issue（v.）發布
~原文 The government issued a warning about heavy rainfall, urging residents to stay indoors and avoid unnecessary travel.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: C______y to his parents' expectations, Walter decided to major in visual art rather than law in university.
= Contrary
~詞義 contrary（adj.）相反的
~原文 Contrary to his parents' expectations, Walter decided to major in visual art rather than law in university.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The lawyer tried hard to c______e the judge of the accused man's innocence.
= convince
~詞義 convince（v.）說服
~原文 The lawyer tried hard to convince the judge of the accused man's innocence.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It is e______ed that the population of the Earth will reach 8 billion in 2023.
= estimated
~詞義 estimate（v.）估計
~原文 It is estimated that the population of the Earth will reach 8 billion in 2023.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Every team member's effort is e______l to the team's success. We must all try our best!
= essential
~詞義 essential（adj.）不可或缺的
~原文 Every team member's effort is essential to the team's success. We must all try our best!

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Dave had a(n) ______ cold last week, including a fever and bad headache.
A: eventual
B: identical
C: severe
D: annual
= C
~詞義 severe（adj.）嚴重的
~原文 Dave had a(n) severe cold last week, including a fever and bad headache.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The company ______ a long-term strategy that focused on sustainability and protect the environment.
A: composed
B: adopted
C: preserved
D: demanded
= B
~詞義 adopt（v.）採用
~原文 The company adopted a long-term strategy that focused on sustainability and protect the environment.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Both teachers and students should remember that a person's ______ performance does not define their worth.
A: consequent
B: evident
C: initial
D: academic
= D
~詞義 academic（adj.）學業的
~原文 Both teachers and students should remember that a person's academic performance does not define their worth.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Before he became a(n) ______ basketball player in the NBA, LeBron James was a great player in high school.
A: professional
B: eventual
C: original
D: identical
= A
~詞義 professional（adj.）專業的
~原文 Before he became a(n) professional basketball player in the NBA, LeBron James was a great player in high school.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Alice ______ the tea cup from an online store for the very low price of fifty dollars.
A: persuaded
B: acquired
C: commanded
D: identified
= B
~詞義 acquire（v.）獲得
~原文 Alice acquired the tea cup from an online store for the very low price of fifty dollars.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: despite
B: professions
C: incident
D: research
E: involve
F: refer

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The runner managed to reach the finish line ______ having pulled a muscle in his leg during the race.
= A
~詞義 despite（prep.）儘管
~原文 The runner managed to reach the finish line despite having pulled a muscle in his leg during the race.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mr. and Mrs. Wang are both doctors, but they want their children to enter other ______ such as law or teaching.
= B
~詞義 profession（n.）職業
~原文 Mr. and Mrs. Wang are both doctors, but they want their children to enter other professions such as law or teaching.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Before writing her report, Jane conducted ______ on teen mental health, reading studies from several universities.
= D
~詞義 research（n.）研究
~原文 Before writing her report, Jane conducted research on teen mental health, reading studies from several universities.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: When giving the presentation, you may ______ to your notes if necessary.
= F
~詞義 refer（v.）參照;查閱
~原文 When giving the presentation, you may refer to your notes if necessary.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The terrible traffic accident was an unfortunate ______.
= C
~詞義 incident（n.）事件
~原文 The terrible traffic accident was an unfortunate incident.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: accidental
B: access
C: annual
D: percentage
E: reference
F: consequence

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Unidentified hackers gained ______ to many people's email accounts and stole their personal information.
= B
~詞義 access（n.）進入權限
~原文 Unidentified hackers gained access to many people's email accounts and stole their personal information.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sam did not prepare for the midterm at all, and as a(n) ______, he failed several subjects.
= F
~詞義 consequence（n.）後果
~原文 Sam did not prepare for the midterm at all, and as a(n) consequence, he failed several subjects.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The English grammar book includes a vocabulary index for easy ______.
= E
~詞義 reference（n.）查閱
~原文 The English grammar book includes a vocabulary index for easy reference.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Fortunately, the thief was arrested and a large ______ of the stolen goods were recovered.
= D
~詞義 percentage（n.）百分比
~原文 Fortunately, the thief was arrested and a large percentage of the stolen goods were recovered.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: My family spends our ______ holiday at a small cabin by a lake up in the mountains.
= C
~詞義 annual（adj.）每年的
~原文 My family spends our annual holiday at a small cabin by a lake up in the mountains.
